title: Elysian Band — Statement
subtitle: The Elysian Cut™ set full circle — an elongated light that never closes.

stone.origin: Natural. Full eternity. Bez Ambar proprietary elongated cut.

description: The Elysian Band in Bez Ambar's proprietary Elysian Cut™ — an elongated form that falls between an oval and a baguette, designed for a different kind of light. Full eternity. 0.50 ct stones, approximately 9.4 ct total weight. VVS clarity, G-H color. 18-karat white gold. Also available as a halfway band (2ELS-50H). Ref 2ELS-50.
